chunks: Give rain from Thee which should be life giving, satisfying, thorough, wide-scattered, purified, blissful, plentiful and invigorating. Its vegetation should be exuberant its branches full of fruits and its leaves green. With it Thou reinvigorates the weak among Thy creatures and bringest back to life the dead among Thy cities.

key_terms.سُقْيَا: Rain or drink, specifically referring to the blessing of rain in this context

ai.seo_question: What are the qualities of rain requested in the Shia supplication for rain from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This supplication, attributed to Imam Ali (AS) in *Nahj al-Balagha*, reflects the Shia tradition of *istisqa'* (seeking rain) as a means of divine mercy and agricultural renewal. It emphasizes rain's role not only in sustaining the physical environment but also in revitalizing the 'weak' servants, highlighting a holistic view of spiritual and material well-being. The language underscores the transformative power of divine blessing, connecting natural phenomena with the spiritual state of the community.
